name: cardapio-digital
description: Cardápio digital multiestabelecimento (backend NestJS + frontend Angular)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm start -w frontend"
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test --if-present
scripts.analyze:frontend: npm run build --workspace frontend && npx esbuild-visualizer --metadata frontend/dist/Projetinho/browser/stats.json --filename frontend/dist/Projetinho/browser/stats.html || echo 'Execute ng build com --stats-json ou use source-map-explorer no build gerado'
